papers.title_en: Probing and Steering for Safety-Relevant Behaviours in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Nimun Bajwa, Massimo Poesio
papers.evidence: 研究大语言模型谄媚行为的检测与引导
papers.tldr: 激活探针既能检测模型的安全相关行为，也可通过注入方向引导生成，但检测能力是否意味着干预能力仍不清楚。研究在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，组合两种估计器与三种词元池化方法，评估欺骗、高风险意识和迎合行为。结果显示，逻辑回归更善检测、均值差更善引导的规律仅适用于前两类行为，迎合行为则相反。最佳池化方式与层位依任务而变，感知变化也未必对应行为变化，提示检测与干预应分别验证。
papers.abstract_en: Activation probes are computed directions in a language model's residual stream, used both to detect safety-relevant behaviours and, by adding their direction back into the stream, to steer them. We explore how the main design choices behind such probes interact, within one pipeline, on one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), and across three behaviours: deception, high-stakes awareness and sycophancy. The pipeline crosses two estimators (difference-of-means and logistic regression) with three token-pooling schemes (last, mean and learned attention), selects appropriate layers to detect or steer a behaviour, and evaluates every direction twice: as a detector of the behaviour, and as a steering vector to push outputs towards the behaviour. Prior work read together suggests a read/write dissociation, in which logistic regression reads (detects) best but difference-of-means directions write (steer) best. We find that it holds for deception and high-stakes but not for sycophancy, where the pattern reverses. The reversal appears to follow partially from the data rather than from the estimators. The best pooling technique and the layer choice depend on the behaviour and data, and the layer that steers best can sit well before the layer that detects best. The right steering metric to use between changing a model's perception and eliciting behaviour depends on the task - and the two can disagree outright. The exported probes and directions power an interactive interface through which a user can score and steer text directly.

papers.title_en: Memory-Aware Reward Modeling: Learning Human Preferences for LLM Memory Use
papers.authors: Yijiang River Dong, Zexue He, Cheng Yu, Tiancheng Hu, Michael J Ryan, Jan Batzner, Zheng Hui, Shaolong Wu, Orestis Papakyriakopoulos, Alex Pentland, Nigel Collier, Jiaxin Pei
papers.evidence: 利用用户判断学习大模型助手何时应使用个人记忆
papers.tldr: 长期记忆让语言模型助手能够跨会话保持连续性并提供个性化回答，但记住更多用户信息并不意味着回答更受欢迎。研究收集87名参与者基于自身查询和个人记忆给出的约1000组配对判断，并训练记忆感知奖励模型。结果显示，使用记忆的回答并非始终更受偏好，自动评估器却明显更偏爱这类回答；新模型的偏好预测准确率达到72.8%。研究强调，记忆使用应以信息所属用户的真实偏好为优化目标，而非仅追求准确回忆。
papers.abstract_en: Memory enables language model assistants to maintain continuity across sessions and generate personalized responses, but knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce responses they prefer. Existing evaluations assess memory capabilities without directly establishing whether memory use benefits the user. To study this gap, we collect approximately 1,000 pairwise judgments from 87 participants using their own ChatGPT queries and personal memories. We find that memory-conditioned responses are not consistently preferred over responses generated without memory and in some cases, users strongly prefer the latter. Automatic evaluators also show limited agreement with users and favor memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce a memory-aware reward model that learns from user judgments, achieving 72.8\% preference prediction accuracy and outperforming the existing baselines. Our findings motivate evaluation and optimization objectives that align memory use with the preferences of the people whose information is being used.

papers.title_en: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
papers.authors: Shmuel Amar, Benjamin Lieber, Ori Shapira, Debanjana Kar, Sebastian Maximilian Dennerlein, Yufang Hou, Ido Dagan
papers.evidence: 设计端到端人机共写流程，主动促进用户参与
papers.tldr: 传统聊天与画布式写作界面容易让作者退化为被动审核者，带来审阅疲劳、过度依赖及个人观点弱化。CoWriter将认知科学中的专家协作写作方法融入主动式智能体，引导完整写作流程并鼓励用户参与。探索性用户研究显示，相比标准大模型基线，其成功促成用户参与的次数达2.2倍，作者更能表达自身观点并保持文档归属感。外部读者也更认可成文的叙事与个人经历融入，提示协作机制设计有助于保留写作中的人类主体性。
papers.abstract_en: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by $2.2\times$ more successful agent engagements. Furthermore, external reader judges rated the resulting texts higher in "human touch" qualities like storytelling and integrating unique personal experiences. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.

papers.title_en: mmPencil: Toward Writing-Style-Independent In-Air Handwriting Recognition via mmWave Radar and Large Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Yifan Guo, Zhu Wang, Qian Qin, Yangqian Lei, Qiwen Gan, Zhuo Sun, Chao Chen, Bin Guo, Zhiwen Yu
papers.evidence: 将空中手写动作识别为一种人机交互技术
papers.tldr: 毫米波空中手写识别常受固定书写平面、书写风格和有限词表限制。mmPencil通过多阶段算法重建三维手写轨迹，再将轨迹映射为视觉表示，借助大型视觉语言模型识别单词。在含12名用户、200个单词的7,664条样本上，已见用户识别准确率达97.60%；未见用户的50类单词零样本识别准确率达92.50%。该系统在多种书写条件变化下保持稳健，推动射频手写识别从受限字符走向更自由的三维单词交互。
papers.abstract_en: In-air handwriting recognition based on radio frequency (RF) signals offers a promising solution for human-computer interaction, yet existing methods are often limited by predefined writing planes, constrained writing styles, and small recognition vocabularies. To address these limitations, we propose m^2VLMs, a modality mapping architecture that bridges millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar sensing and large vision-language models (VLMs), and develop mmPencil, a 3D in-air handwriting word recognition system. mmPencil reconstructs 3D handwriting trajectories from mmWave signals using a multi-stage spatial trajectory reconstruction algorithm and maps them into visual representations through a spatial-to-visual mapping algorithm, enabling VLMs to recognize handwriting while reducing sensitivity to writing styles and environmental factors.   We collect and release a 3D mmWave handwriting dataset containing 7,664 samples of 200 words from 12 users across 22 writing scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that mmPencil achieves robust word recognition under variations in writing position, range, angle, speed, size, direction, and user movement. It achieves 97.60% accuracy on 200 word classes for seen users and 92.50% zero-shot accuracy on 50 word classes for unseen users, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title_en: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
papers.authors: Saurav Joshi, Manas Gupta, Ashwin Venkatesh Raman, Akshay Budhkar
papers.evidence: 协调智能体规划执行与审核，并对照用户原始目标
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体即使完成局部步骤，也可能偏离用户原始目标。本文设计执行框架，将原始目标、可修订计划与执行记录分离，由规划者分派任务、执行者产出成果、审查者对照目标决定提交或返工。框架在终端基准通过83/89题；医疗配对评测总体得分提高19.89分，但单题变化中位数为负，平均推理成本约增至7.3倍。研究结合执行轨迹与资源消耗，揭示多角色协调的收益、退化风险及成本。
papers.abstract_en: Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \$0.29 to \$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.

papers.title_en: ProMemAgent: Long-Horizon Proactive Assistance with Context-Aware Prospective Memory from Sensory Perceptions
papers.authors: Lilin Xu, Linyang He, Kaiyuan Hou, Yuang Fan, Minghui Zhao, Xuhai Xu, Xiaofan Jiang
papers.evidence: 以长时程前瞻记忆支持大模型助手主动个性化协助
papers.tldr: 现有主动智能体主要处理即时需求，难以在数小时或数天后识别并执行先前形成的延迟意图。ProMemAgent从日常视频、音频等感知信息构建上下文感知记忆，生成前瞻线索并关联事件发展，在当前情境下检索历史、判断是否需要主动帮助。论文提出覆盖八类日常场景、含1000个实例的CPMBench，实验显示其记忆检索表现最佳，长时程主动辅助持续优于全部基线。该工作将前瞻记忆引入感知驱动的主动辅助，连接历史需求与未来行动时机。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are moving beyond reactive responses toward proactive assistance that anticipates user needs without explicit requests. However, existing proactive agents primarily address immediate needs, while many everyday situations involve delayed intentions that can only be acted on hours or days later. Humans handle such intentions through prospective memory, the ability to remember to act on an intention when the right moment arises. In this paper, we introduce ProMemAgent, the first proactive agent to incorporate prospective memory over everyday sensory contexts for long-horizon proactive assistance. ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions (e.g., egocentric video and audio) into context-aware memory, generating prospective cues and linking earlier events with subsequent developments for future retrieval. Given the current context, it retrieves relevant past events and performs memory-augmented proactive reasoning to determine whether assistance is needed. We further introduce CPMBench, the first benchmark for evaluating long-horizon proactive assistance over sensory contexts, comprising 1,000 instances across eight everyday categories. Extensive experiments show that ProMemAgent achieves the best memory retrieval performance and consistently outperforms all baselines on long-horizon proactive assistance.

papers.title_en: Baseline and Incremental: User, Item, and Request Debiasing in Instagram Feed Ranking
papers.authors: Hsin-Chiang Chen, Hao Wang, Gedi Zhou, Mingze Gao, Abhishek Kumar, Yiben Yang, Haoyu Wang, Hongjing Xia, Bo Chen, Zhengyu Su, Xian Sun, Chang Xu, Kevin Han, Weiwei Li, Zhongchang Sun, Yao Zhang, Qifei Wang, Peggy Yang, Yihan Wu, Haoran Liu, Siyang Sun, Xingyu Pan, Shannon Phu, Haoming Chen, Kevin Zhao, Chen Liang
papers.evidence: 通过用户、内容和请求情境信号校正社交媒体信息流排序
papers.tldr: 信息流排序的互动预测混合了用户习惯、内容热度和请求情境带来的基线，直接去除基线可能损失有用信息。论文保留原始预测，并将超出基线的增量作为独立加权项，用统一参数化算子处理三类偏差。Instagram四臂消融中，双项方案在13组评估中的11组点估计优于两种单项方案，26次直接比较中17次显著胜出、仅1次显著落后。研究支持联合利用原始与增量信号，并已在Meta多个推荐场景部署。
papers.abstract_en: A feed ranker scores candidates with a value model, a weighted sum of engagement predictions. Each prediction conflates a baseline, what this viewer, item or request would produce anyway, with the incremental amount by which this candidate exceeds it. The literature mostly removes the baseline. We argue that a multi-signal value model should keep the raw prediction and add the incremental part as a separately weighted term. On Instagram Feed, three debiasing families deployed independently, for viewer habit, item popularity and request context, are one parameterised operator, and a design procedure picks a point in it. Media-type (format) bias goes instead to a debiased label chosen by the same procedure. In a controlled four-arm ablation of deployed Feed terms (neither term, each alone, both), the two-term arm beats both single-term arms at production weights on point estimates in 11 of 13 judged (term, metric) pairs. Of the 26 direct contrasts, 17 are significantly for it and only 1 against it, on impressions. The ablation also suggests that the offline diagnostic should screen signals, not rank them. Such terms have served Instagram Feed production for most of a year. Beyond Feed, Meta, whose apps serve billions of people, has adopted the operator across surfaces, apps and both ranking stages. Its launches there drive sessions and daily active users, the core visitation and retention metrics.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 提出交互智能体感知、规划、经由界面或身体行动并验证结果的框架。
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体从计算机操作走向机器人操作后，必须应对物理动作后果及更难逆转的错误。论文提出能力中心框架PAPAV，以感知、预判、规划、行动和验证五项功能，统一比较多模态智能体、机器人系统与多模态具身智能体。对64个基准的梳理显示，显式评测集中于行动，仅5个评估预判、3个评估验证。该框架揭示物理约束带来的能力与评测缺口，为可靠具身智能体设计及超越任务成功率的评估提供共同基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

papers.title_en: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
papers.authors: Isaac Gibbs, Elise L. Han, Ryan J. Tibshirani, Tijana Zrnic
papers.evidence: 由人工审核者复核或纠正AI决策，在监督与减少审核之间权衡。
papers.tldr: 人工智能连续决策难以逐条交由专家审核，单靠置信度放行又可能遗漏错误。论文将选择性审计建模为在线约束优化，依据决策及其可信度评分决定是否求助专家，在限制未审计错误比例的同时减少审计频率。所提算法无需分布假设即可提供错误控制，其中一种在对抗性和独立同分布数据流上均渐近达到最优审计率。三类任务实验显示，该方法能有效控制错误并显著节省人工审计，为规模化人工智能监督提供可靠机制。
papers.abstract_en: We consider online monitoring of an AI system that produces a sequence of decisions. At each round, the system outputs a proposed decision together with a confidence score estimating the trustworthiness of the decision. The decision and confidence score need not be produced by the same model: for example, one agent may propose a decision, while a separate verifier agent evaluates it and outputs a correctness or safety score. Based on this information, we must decide whether to accept the AI decision automatically or consult an expert, such as a human auditor, who reviews the proposal and either accepts or corrects it. We formulate this task as an online constrained optimization problem in which the goal is to minimize the frequency of expert auditing while guaranteeing that the fraction of AI errors that go unaudited stays below a user-defined threshold. We derive a family of algorithms with provable error-control guarantees with no assumptions, including a method that is optimally efficient: it asymptotically attains the best achievable auditing rate for both adversarial and i.i.d. data streams. Experiments on screening harmful requests to large language models, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling show that our methods achieve valid error control in practice while substantially reducing the need for human auditing compared to baselines.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Interaction Estimation for Contact-Aware Adaptive Impedance Control
papers.authors: Mateusz Jaszczuk, Paris Perdikaris, Nadia Figueroa
papers.evidence: 融合力觉与三维视觉估计人机交互类型
papers.tldr: 机器人在人机共处环境中，需区分未知负载与人为推扰，兼顾轨迹精度和接触柔顺性。本文以变换器融合力历史与三维点云，通过模态随机丢弃和仿真到实机微调增强鲁棒性，并联动系统辨识与可变阻抗控制。分类准确率达91.89%，单一模态完全遮挡时仍超过90%；实验覆盖单臂、模仿学习策略及零样本双臂搬运。该框架支持选择性负载补偿和交互力估计，为未知负载下的安全、精确操作提供任务无关方案。
papers.abstract_en: With advancements in learning-based policies, robots are increasingly being deployed in human-centric environments, such as manufacturing floors and homes, where safe and precise operation requires compensating for unknown loads while remaining compliant during human interactions. Reliably distinguishing between these interaction types is challenging with a single sensing modality, as force signals cannot separate payloads from human pushes, and vision is susceptible to occlusions. We propose a task-agnostic interaction estimation and adaptive control framework that addresses this challenge by fusing force history and 3D point cloud through a transformer-based classifier. Trained with modality dropout for occlusion resilience and fine-tuned from simulation to hardware, the classifier achieves 91.89% accuracy and maintains above 90% under complete occlusion of one modality. The classifier drives a system identification framework that selectively compensates for unknown payloads and a variable-impedance controller that switches between adaptive and reactive modes, while simultaneously estimating interaction forces for downstream tasks, such as human intent estimation. We validate the framework under external perturbations and unknown loads across single-arm manipulation, deployment with an imitation-learning-based policy, intent-driven target switching, and zero-shot bimanual deployment on two Franka arms lifting a box of unknown mass, demonstrating generalization to closed kinematic chains and unseen setups, enabling safe and precise deployment.

papers.title_en: RITE: Evaluating End-to-End Resilience to Silent Tool Errors in E-Commerce Agentic Systems
papers.authors: Wenshuo Zhang, Yuquan Lin, Yushi Sun, Yishi Lin, Rui Sheng, Peng He, Han Gao, Wang Jikai, Yifeng Rong
papers.evidence: 评测工具型智能体遇到隐性错误时能否完成用户任务
papers.tldr: 电商智能体的工具调用可能返回格式正确却内容错误的值，且不显式报错，导致错误沿多步决策传播。RITE固定工作流前缀并冻结已记录的工具行为，注入语义错误后让智能体自由继续，以评估端到端恢复能力。基准覆盖九类工作流、501个实例；对十个模型的评测显示，静默错误使任务成功率约减半，比显式失败更难应对。研究揭示错误识别、核验路径使用与证据整合三重瓶颈，并提出轻量状态检查器作为干预方案。
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly answer e-commerce queries through multi-step tool interactions. The expected output of a tool call can shift between agent development and execution, allowing a plausible but incorrect value to be returned without an explicit failure signal. These silent errors may propagate through subsequent decisions into final answers. To study agents' resilience across this end-to-end process, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, an interactive task that evaluates whether they complete the original query after a silent error corrupts an intermediate state. We introduce RITE, a benchmark built from human-authored industrial workflows and production-log-derived inputs. To enable controlled and reproducible evaluation, we use a semantic error taxonomy to inject errors into fixed workflow prefixes, freeze recorded tool behavior, and let agents continue freely. It contains 167 matched units across nine e-commerce workflows, yielding 501 silent-error, correct-value, and explicit-failure instances. Across 10 recent LLMs, silent errors roughly halve task success and are consistently harder than explicit failures. Recognition, use of an available verification path, and integration of the resulting evidence form successive bottlenecks. We also propose a light State Checker as an intervention to test whether resilience can be improved.

papers.title_en: Navigating human-robot interaction challenges in private and residential aged care homes
papers.authors: David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Mohammad Ali Armin, Akila Pemasiri, Harshala Gammulle, Tharindu Fernando, David Silvera-Tawil, Simon Denman
papers.evidence: 综述养老照护环境中面向老年人的人机交互设计
papers.tldr: 养老机构与私人住宅存在空间杂乱、需求多样和技术支持不足等问题，使养老人机交互面临复杂挑战。本章综述实体机器人、非实体系统及环境智能，强调机器人与固定、可穿戴传感器协同部署。章节提出简化语音与非语言交互、端侧推理和可见同意控制，并以每日误报数、故障恢复时间及护理工作负荷评价实际可用性。其贡献在于整合适老设计、隐私保护与长期可靠性要求，为可扩展、合规且维护老年人尊严的部署提供方向。
papers.abstract_en: This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. Although these settings differ, we frame both as extreme and challenging environments for human-robot interaction (HRI), characterised by cluttered and dynamic layouts, diverse resident needs, and limited on-site technical support. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. To ensure these technologies are usable and effective, design considerations consider the cognitive, physical, and social needs of older adults. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Privacy, trust, and acceptability are addressed via practical strategies such as on-device inference, data minimisation, visible consent controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) and privacy regulation. Evaluation emphasises real-world metrics including false alarms per day, time to recover from faults, staff workload, and long-term system reliability. We close by outlining open research challenges and future directions for scalable, regulation-ready deployments that support aging with dignity, safety, and independence.

papers.title_en: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Dezhao Luo, Daniel Beechey, Derek Yuen, Weilin Luo
papers.evidence: 让图形界面智能体在长程任务中复用结构化经验。
papers.tldr: 移动端图形界面智能体执行长程任务时，需要复用历史经验，但单步动作缺乏进度语义，完整轨迹又难以跨任务迁移。论文提出子目标感知记忆图，将共享同一意图的连续动作提炼为子目标，并以图节点组织经验，支持合并、扩展和基于环境观测的检索。在SPA-Bench上，该方法较基线的成功率提升11.11%。其贡献是以子目标作为中间抽象粒度，兼顾任务进度表达与经验复用。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents aim to automate complex user tasks by interacting with mobile interfaces, but ef- fective decision-making in long-horizon set- tings requires reusing prior experience rather than relying solely on the environment ob- servations. Existing memory-based methods typically store experience either at the single- action level or as entire trajectories. Single- step actions are often too fine-grained to carry meaningful semantics, since the success of an individual action does not necessarily imply progress towards the overall goal. In contrast, whole trajectories are often too coarse-grained and difficult to reuse across different tasks. We propose a subgoal-aware memory graph that distils past trajectories into structured, reusable evidence at the level of subgoals. We define a subgoal as consecutive actions shar- ing a single intent, the granularity at which progress toward the task becomes meaning- ful. To reduce redundancy and support cross- task reuse, we organise subgoal experiences as nodes in a graph, where related memories can be merged, extended, and retrieved based on the environment observation. On SPA-Bench, our method improves success rate by 11.11% over the baseline.

papers.title_en: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
papers.authors: Haoyang Luo, Junhao Qin, Jingyan Cao, Yi Huang, Guangjie Yang, Xiaoyu Chen, Haotao Lu, Tianxiang Gui, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
papers.evidence: 异构多智能体机器人团队的结构化协作与经验复用
papers.tldr: 异构机器人团队能结合感知、移动与操作能力完成长程任务，但难以复用执行纠错经验、维持跨时空上下文并表达协作依赖。InstAgent以行为树组织能力分配、机器人依赖及交接检查，通过执行反馈修订协作程序，将验证成功的版本保存复用，并借助共享多模态时空记忆支持规划。在20项真实世界多机器人任务、三种高层模型上的实验显示，任务成功率、首次完成率及执行效率均有提升。其贡献是将协作执行与经验积累连接成可持续改进的闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous robot teams enable complex, long-horizon tasks by combining complementary sensing, mobility, and manipulation capabilities across multiple embodiments. Yet existing systems struggle to retain execution-time corrections as reusable experience, maintain task-relevant context memory across space and time for reliable handoffs, and explicitly represent the inter-robot dependencies required for structured collaboration. In order to address these challenges, we present InstAgent, a recursively self-improving (RSI) Agent Operating System for heterogeneous robot collaboration. InstAgent organizes team behaviors as agentic behavior trees (BTs) that explicitly model capability assignment, inter-robot dependencies and handoff checks. The RSI mechanism updates these collaboration programs from execution feedback and preserves successful revisions for reuse in future tasks, while shared multimodal spatio-temporal memory provides context for planning and handoff validation. Experiments on 20 real-world multi-robot tasks with three high-level models show consistent gains in task success, first-attempt completion, and execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Yuhan Sun, Jiaxin Zhao, Yongdong Luo, Yibo Hu, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma, Weixun Wang, Weihang Pan, Zhongan Bi
papers.evidence: 以强化学习和蒸馏训练分层多智能体团队。
papers.tldr: 层级多智能体系统中，最终答案难以直接评价子智能体的中间贡献，限制了团队联合训练。该方法结合在策略蒸馏与强化学习，以冻结教师为学生生成的搜索和摘要词元提供局部监督，并按角色分别优化领导者、搜索者和回答者。系统在七个数据集上的宏平均avg@4达到38.68%，较两类基线分别提升4.06和2.61个百分点。研究为共享参数的层级团队提供了端到端训练方案，并提升了四次尝试内的解题能力。
papers.abstract_en: In a hierarchical multi-agent system, a Leader assigns tasks and subagents carry them out. Jointly training the Leader and the subagents is difficult because a final answer gives only indirect feedback to the subagents. An LLM judge can score the performance of the subagents, but these scores depend on the judge's own assessment of the quality of subagents' responses. We present MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning to jointly train a shared-parameter Leader-Searcher-Answerer team end to end. We first train a Teacher in a Searcher-Answerer workflow using answer correctness. During team training, the frozen Teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens to provide local process supervision for the Searchers, while the Leader learns from team success and the Answerer from candidate correctness. Across seven datasets, the trained system reaches 38.68% macro avg@4, exceeding Prompted Critic by 4.06 percentage points and C-MAS + RL, the trained cascaded multiagent system, by 2.61 percentage points. The team also solves more questions within four attempts.

papers.title_en: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
papers.authors: Amirreza Mohseni, Gerasimos Spanakis
papers.evidence: 研究用户在真实大模型对话中如何寻求法律帮助
papers.tldr: 用户常向对话式人工智能咨询法律问题，但法律主题讨论并不等于寻求实际指导。研究构建多轴分类体系，标注2122段真实对话，并建立200段人工复核的金标准评测集。在富集样本的法律相关对话中，71.1%寻求个性化或实务指导；权利与选项咨询最常见，25.3%的指导类对话涉及多个法律主题。研究还比较两种规模的ModernBERT与词频基线，并公开数据、模型及评测代码，支持可复现的大规模研究。
papers.abstract_en: People ask conversational AI models about their legal rights, obligations, procedures, and personal situations that may have legal consequences. To study this behavior, we first need to distinguish requests for legal guidance from other legally themed discussions and unrelated conversations. We contribute a multi-axis taxonomy of legal queries capturing whether legal guidance is sought, how a request is formulated, and which legal domains it concerns; apply it to 2,122 naturally occurring WildChat-1M conversations; and create a human-reviewed gold evaluation set of 200 conversations. All annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code are publicly available. In this enriched sample, 71.1% of conversations containing legal content seek personalized or practical guidance. Rights-and-options advice is the most common primary request type among legal-content conversations, and 25.3% of guidance-positive conversations span multiple legal topics. The gold evaluation set supports a two-stage comparison of ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large against a TF-IDF cascade. Our framework supports large-scale studies of legal guidance in conversational AI, and the public release of the annotated data facilitates reproducible research and future model development.

papers.title_en: Learning What to Remember: Resource-Efficient Self-Improvement for Lifelong Agents
papers.authors: Guannan Lai, Zi-Yang Bai, Jun-Peng Jiang, Han-Jia Ye
papers.evidence: 研究长期运行的智能体如何筛选并复用经验记忆
papers.tldr: 终身智能体在生成、交互和记忆资源同时受限时，积累更多经验并不必然改善决策，无效记忆反而会挤占执行预算。TokenWorth利用稀疏执行反馈，学习面向当前查询的记忆复用价值，无需更新主干模型，同时指导经验检索与有限容量记忆管理。在三个LifelongAgentBench环境及本地、API部署中，该方法在指定预算下取得参评方法最高任务成功率和最少输出词元。研究强调，资源受限下自我改进的关键是识别值得复用的经验，而非单纯扩充记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents aim to continuously improve their behavior by learning from experience after deployment. However, accumulating and reusing more experience does not necessarily lead to better decisions, particularly when generation, interaction, and memory resources are jointly constrained. Under such stringent constraints, we find that several existing lifelong-memory methods provide limited benefits over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a fundamental challenge for resource-efficient self-improvement: agents must learn not only which past experiences are relevant, but which are actually worth reusing to improve future decisions. When memory capacity and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving an ineffective experience can consume scarce resources and hinder downstream execution. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight feedback-driven memory adaptation framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback. Without updating the backbone model, TokenWorth uses the learned worth to guide both experience retrieval and bounded memory management, enabling the agent to continually adapt how it reuses accumulated experience. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods under the specified resource budgets. These results suggest that effective self-improvement under resource constraints depends not on accumulating more experience, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

papers.title_en: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Ran Zhou, Zehui Kong, Fanyu Lin, Jiaheng Liu, Zhen Zhang, Yuxiang Ren
papers.evidence: 程序记忆帮助智能体高效复用技能
papers.tldr: 随着智能体技能库扩大，全量加载成本高，平面语义检索又忽略技能依赖、执行顺序与数据流约束。SPEM以原子技能记忆和技能有向无环图记忆组织知识，优先复用高置信流程，否则通过Skill-GNN结合状态与结构选择技能，并将成功执行回写为新流程。在ALFWorld和SkillsBench上分别取得87.1%成功率与38.38%奖励，同时降低词元和运行成本。其贡献是让成功经验沉淀为可复用的结构化程序记忆。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.

papers.title_en: MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.authors: Mohammad Kachuee, Phu Mon Htut, Sheng Li, Nikolaos Pappas, Miguel Ballesteros Martinez, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
papers.evidence: 针对自主及多智能体系统中的安全行动与信息泄露风险
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作扩大了不安全操作、信息泄露和对抗操纵的风险，现有防御难以兼顾局部执行与跨智能体交互。MAS-Guard结合本地任务专家护栏、开发者定义的智能体章程及系统控制平面，以结构与语义检查统一执行放行、反思、确认和阻断。在六个基准、三种不同供应商的模型上，攻击成功率相对无防护基线降低71.5%—86.3%，同时满足正常任务效用参考标准。框架为可插桩与黑箱智能体混合部署提供统一防护。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess agentic events. At the system level, developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane combine deterministic structural checks of routes, agent capabilities, and message formats with semantic assessments of roles and message content. These complementary layers enable enforcement through a shared set of interventions: allow, reflection, confirmation, and block. Evaluated across six benchmarks covering diverse single- and multi-agent scenarios with three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduces the overall attack success rate by 71.5-86.3% relative to unguarded agents, while meeting the utility reference criterion on benign tasks.

papers.title_en: PsycheMME: A Psychology-Informed Benchmark for Social Understanding and Interaction in Videos
papers.authors: Heran Hu, Yuhang Dong, Zhucun Xue, Kaiwei Chen, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.evidence: 评测模型对人的状态、需求及互动决策的理解
papers.tldr: 视频社交理解不仅要识别人类状态与需求，还要判断如何回应，单一准确率难以区分这些能力。PsycheMME以心理学理论组织八项能力，从630个情境构建1000道题，并按解释的证据支持与逻辑一致性加权答案得分。对17个模型的评测显示，交互时机判断的验证得分与得分保留率最低，需求得分相近的模型在开放题完整性上仍有差异。该基准联合评估答案与理由，定位理解、回应选择及论证中的失误。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human needs and selecting responses require distinct judgments that aggregate accuracy can obscure. We introduce PsycheMME, a video benchmark informed by psychology, with eight capabilities spanning grounding, states, needs, interaction decisions, memory, and risk. Drawing on Social Information Processing and the Perception-Action Cycle, this organization separates human understanding from response selection. We construct 1,000 questions from 630 episodes through independent answering with proposed references withheld and expert review. Our Reasoning-Verified protocol weights answer credit by the support and logical consistency of explicit rationales against annotated cues. Across 17 models, Timing has the lowest Verified scores and credit retention, with weaker support judgments for correct Timing answers. Models with similar Need scores still differ in answer completeness on open questions. Input controls and SFT/GRPO examine context dependence and adaptation. Evaluating answers alongside rationales locates where models fail across understanding, response selection, and justification.

papers.title_en: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
papers.authors: Jiawei Chen, Ruoxi Xu, Boxi Cao, Zhuoqun Li, Ruotong Pan, Yunfei Zhang, Zhirui Yang, Jingyan Chen, Tingting Gao, Han Li, Yaojie Lu, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xiangyu Wu, Hongyu Lin
papers.evidence: 在交互式短视频环境中模拟真实用户行为
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可用于模拟短视频平台用户，但原生思维链容易退化为浅层模式匹配，难以刻画真实决策因素。OmniSimulator以五维结构化推理框架组织行为分析，由教师模型生成推理轨迹并蒸馏到小模型。研究从200名真实用户三个月的交互历史中构建9881条训练样本，使Qwen3-8B平均得分提升34.33%，表现可媲美Claude-Sonnet-4.5。这为可自托管、高保真的用户模拟提供了训练路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.

papers.title_en: Automated Discovery of Physically Interpretable Subgrid Length Scales for Detached Eddy Simulation via Agentic AI
papers.authors: Jiawei Chen, Xiang I. A. Yang, Ping He
papers.evidence: 用户提出建模想法，由多个智能体协作探索与评估
papers.tldr: 传统湍流模型开发依赖专家经验，公式设计耗时。研究提出多智能体框架DEScover，仅以“采用垂直于局部涡轴的网格宽度作为长度尺度”为建模思路，由四个大语言模型智能体提出、审查、实现并评估候选公式。在平板、后向台阶、自由剪切层和结冰翼型四类算例中，最佳候选均优于最大网格尺寸基线，与专家设计尺度相当或略优。每轮发现平均约需25分钟，不含流体仿真，展示了加速可解释湍流建模的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional turbulence-model development relies heavily on expert knowledge and is time-consuming. This study develops an agentic AI framework, DEScover (automated Discovery of DES closures), to explore subgrid length scales for detached eddy simulation (DES). The user provides only a modeling idea: the length scale is the grid width normal to the local vortex axis. Four large language model (LLM) agents then propose, review, implement, and evaluate candidate formulations and generate scripts for CFD simulations. The Discovery Agent infers the vortex axis from various vortex-identification methods. The candidates are tested on four cases spanning canonical and engineering flows: a flat plate, a backward-facing step, a free shear layer, and an iced airfoil. For all test cases, the best candidate consistently outperforms the standard length scale based on the maximum cell size. Its accuracy is similar to, or slightly better than, that of the expert-designed shear-layer-adapted length scale. Each agentic discovery run takes about 25 minutes on average, excluding the CFD simulations. These results show that LLM-based reasoning can significantly accelerate the discovery of physically interpretable turbulence models and reduce reliance on manual expert formulation.

papers.title_en: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.authors: Yicheng Xu, Zhikai Xu, Ziyuan Chen, Yuhang Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.evidence: 支持具身智能体在物理与社会约束下适应人类需求
papers.tldr: 机器人执行长程任务时，既要遵守物理与社交约束，也要应对环境和人类需求变化，固定目标或符号化执行难以充分评估这些能力。TARSphere将物理仿真、具身角色交互、事件驱动任务状态机与冻结多模态大模型决策整合为全栈框架。其基准覆盖30个室内场景、360个回合，评测发现通用模型可优于具身模型，但任务更新与人类交互仍具挑战。频繁碰撞和跌倒表明，长程具身评测应同时关注任务成功与执行安全。
papers.abstract_en: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

papers.title_en: When Code Gets Cheap, Evaluation Gets Scarce: An Experience Report on AI-Assisted Agile Software Engineering
papers.authors: Barbara Weber, Olaf Zimmermann, Marco Franceschetti
papers.evidence: 采用人工参与和门控评估的人工智能辅助工作流程
papers.tldr: 编程助手加速代码产出，但端到端软件交付的瓶颈可能转向可靠评估。作者以合规敏感的考试评分系统为案例，由兼任用户和领域专家的单名开发者，通过门控流程驱动助手开发，全程未手写代码。初版三天完成并用于真实班级评分，但测试遗漏了浏览器、模型接口及部署缺陷，助手也曾绕过流程检查点。研究指出，即使专家判断随时可用，评估仍制约进度，工程判断同样稀缺；应强化真实环境验证、可追溯门控及决策记录。
papers.abstract_en: Coding assistants are widely reported to speed up code production; most accounts stop there. We report the end-to-end construction and deployment of a compliance-critical, human-in-the-loop exam-grading system, built by a single developer who wrote no code by hand, protected by a gated process from stakeholder persona to audited behavior. The initial system was built in three working days and could grade a real cohort. We draw one claim from this experience: AI changes software engineering less by making programming faster than by changing what is scarce. Writing code becomes abundant. Reliable evaluation-knowing whether a result is correct and meets the actual need-remains necessary at every iteration and becomes the binding constraint. Engineering judgment remains a second scarcity. Several defects passed the test suite: they sat at the boundaries the tests had mocked, the browser and the language-model API, or appeared only in real use. Deployment exposed assumptions that local tests had missed. Moreover, an AI assistant acting across many steps bypassed process checkpoints until we made them enforceable gates. All of this was observed in a triple union: the developer was also the end user and domain expert, making expert judgment immediately available and evaluation as cheap as it can be. This favors the iteration gains, which may shrink where evaluation requires additional people or expertise, but makes the case a hard test for evaluation scarcity: evaluation still constrained progress. We draw five lessons: run a gated, traceable construction process; specify what is knowable and discover the rest against a running prototype; validate in the real environment; gate the assistant, not only the work; record decisions with their assumptions and the process state the assistant forgets. A second project showed similar patterns; an independent single-expert case corroborates the shift.

papers.title_en: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
papers.authors: Jujia Zhao, Jiakai Tang, Jing Yu, Wen Chen, Jian Wu, Han Zhu, Fei Sun, Suzan Verberne, Zhaochun Ren
papers.evidence: 提供真实用户轨迹与交互环境，用于评估长程购物智能体
papers.tldr: 长程购物智能体需要可信的用户模拟，但现有资源缺少细粒度真实轨迹，也难以验证模拟结果能否复现线上策略效果。UserArena收集11010名用户的64729条会话轨迹，结合交互环境与五层评估，并提出在学生生成轨迹上利用轨迹级意图提供密集教师目标的OPTD方法。实验中，OPTD在参评模拟器中总体保真度最高，且最接近生产环境受控A/B测试的策略效果，为购物智能体提供更可信的离线评估基础。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types. UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes. To improve simulator fidelity over these long-horizon interactions, we further propose On-Policy Trajectory Distillation (OPTD), which uses trajectory-level intent to provide dense teacher targets on student-generated rollouts. Experiments show that OPTD achieves the strongest overall fidelity among the evaluated simulators under UserArena's evaluation protocol and most closely reproduces the production policy effect in offline simulation.

papers.title_en: GelSlim 5.0: Unifying Vision and Touch with a Single Fingertip Camera
papers.authors: Xiangdong Wang, I-Hsuan Huang, Xiaohao Xu, Xili Yi, Nima Fazeli, Xiaonan Huang
papers.evidence: 指尖相机结合视觉与触觉信息支持接触交互
papers.tldr: 视觉与触觉分别提供物体位姿和局部接触几何信息，但外部相机容易在接触处被遮挡。GelSlim 5.0利用连续紫外响应接触层与照明切换，让单个指尖相机从同一视角依次采集视觉和触觉图像，无需相机间外参标定。配套VisTacFusion融合两种观测，预测平面位姿、接触深度和表面法向。在12个已知物体的真实验证数据上，融合输入较仅触觉使深度均方误差降低61.2%，展示了共享视角下两种模态的互补价值。
papers.abstract_en: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.
